description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quad Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Dark)], [Dual Awoken Scion Sorceress Mode I (Y'shtola)] and [Black Magic/Witch Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Scion Sorceress Mode I (Y'shtola)
description.text: Black Magic and Witch abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic and Witch abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Black Magic and Witch abilities
